jobs.title: Senior Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN #TEAMRC

WHY WORK FOR RC ENGINEERING?

The Engineering Services Department consists of three separate sections Project Management/Project Delivery, Land Development, and Transportation, with a total of twenty-four (24) staff members that span various roles.

From its earliest days, the City of Rancho Cucamonga was dubbed the "City with a Plan" and over the past forty years, we have been creating a World Class Community. So, what does this have to do with engineering? Everything! Engineering is more than simply building and maintaining roads, it's about providing the built environment that is the context for the people and the places of our lives. As we move into our fifth decade as a City, we are continuing to build a World Class Community for our children and grandchildren to enjoy. One that takes the best parts of our past and continues growing and reimagining itself for the future. We are excited to have the opportunity to play a big part in what is coming next for our community. Whether it is through high quality design and construction of the built environment, by ensuring that our environment stays clean and sustainable, or by providing reliable utility services to residents and businesses.

What You Will Be Doing Here At Team Rc

THE POSITION

Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level? We are currently seeking a dynamic individual to join our team to fill a key management and high-level technical role. There is currently one vacancy, and depending on qualifications, the top candidate will be chosen to fill a Senior role.

The Project Management/Project Delivery Team consists of three assistant engineers, two associate engineers and one principal engineer. Reporting directly to the Principal Engineer, the Senior Engineer position offers the chance to make a significant impact and operate with a high degree of autonomy.

The Senior Civil Engineer is responsible for bringing a high level of technical expertise to assist our Associate and Assistant Engineers through complex capital projects. The ideal candidate for this role will embody a facilitation mindset and will also be well versed in a broad range of engineering skill sets related to Project Delivery, including but not limited to complex project and contract management, sound cost estimating strategies, creating economics of scale, understanding constructability, and strategic planning.

Capital Management

The Capital Management Section is responsible for the preparation and implementation of the City’s Major Projects Program (MPP). This includes the design, construction, and installation of various public improvements throughout the City. Typical projects include street improvements, storm drain construction, railroad crossing improvements, and facility construction or upgrades. The Capital Management section also manages funding programs related to the implementation of the MPP and other operational functions including Measure I 2010-2040, State Gas Tax and Road Maintenance and Repair Funding, along with State and Federal grants.

YOUR IMPACT

Notable Projects You May Work On

As Part Of The Engineering Services Team, You’ll Have The Opportunity To Be a Part Of Rewarding Projects That Make a Visible Impact In Our Community. Some Of The Exciting Projects Currently Underway At The City Of Rancho Cucamonga Include

Pavement Management Program Implementation - A city-wide assessment of pavement condition to be able to best plan for future CIP projects and improve our average Pavement Condition Index (PCI).
Active Transportation Plan and Local Roadway Safety Plan Implementation - Two separate planning efforts to set the foundation for prioritizing future infrastructure projects for both the City’s CIP and future grant applications.
City Center Boulevards Project - Oversee design and construction for this transformative project on Haven Avenue and Foothill Boulevard. This project aims to create a City Center adjacent to the City's Civic Center and planned developments along two of the City's primary corridors. The project will remove on vehicular lane to construct a frontage road with complete street elements including enhanced landscaping, street furniture, on-street parking, bicycle facilities, and transit stops.
Phase 2 Heritage Park Bridge Replacement - The reconstruction of two bridges currently servicing pedestrians, equestrians.
Etiwanda Grade Separation Project - A $125 Million investment to construct a new grade separated overcrossing along Etiwanda Avenue over the railroad tracks. Tasks will include identifying funding, closing out the right of way process, and overseeing construction.
Etiwanda Creek Bridges Project - Lead design, environmental clearance and permitting, and construction for one new culvert on Whittram Avenue and a widened culvert on Arrow Avenue.
General Plan Implementation - Reimagining of street cross-sections along our two largest corridors, and ensuring our vision is communicated to developers to achieve desired quality of life improvements for our community.

This Position Might Be Perfect For You If

You are a self-motivated leader who enjoys the flexibility of shifting between coordinating a team and detailed project management.
You have a strong background in project management and overseeing large-scale construction projects.
You are a team-player with a forward-thinking approach to strategic planning processes and a desire to check things off the list.
You enjoy sharing your knowledge with and fostering growth in members of your team.
You tend to find ways to make work processes more efficient and effective.
You are a technically proficient engineer looking to make your next career move.
You are hungry, humble, and smart.

You’ll be responsible for:

Knowing Why! Being the Best! Collaborating Earnestly! and Leaving an Inheritance!
As Senior Civil Engineer, being a technical expert and resource for the Project Management/Project Delivery Section.
Staying informed about required reporting for special funding sources, contract management and changes in codes, laws, or design techniques.
Preparing and delivering reports to various policy making bodies and committees, including City Council.
Working with other Departments, neighboring jurisdictions, and regional agencies to coordinate projects and grant applications to ensure the goals of the City are being met.

For more information regarding these positions, please visit the Senior Civil Engineer job descriptions.

RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE

Application Deadline: Thursday, August 14, 2025

Application Screening completed by Thursday, August 21, 2025

1st Panel Interview: Thursday, August 28, 2025

Tentative Department Interview: Thursday, September 4, 2025

All dates are subject to change at the discretion of the personnel officer**

ARE YOU QUALIFIED

Education And/or Experience

Graduation from an accredited college with a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and four years of progressively responsible professional experience, including experience in directing the work of others involved in engineering project activities or any combination of training and experience that provides the desired knowledge and abilities.

Examples Of Acceptable Substitutions

Minimum Qualifications: A bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, plus four (4) years of progressively responsible professional-level experience
in Civil Engineering, including experience in directing the work of others involved in engineering project activities.

Substitution: A total of eight (8) years of progressively responsible professional-level experience
in Civil Engineering, including experience in directing the work of others involved in engineering project activities may substituted for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Knowledge of engineering principles, methods and practices; project development, design and construction; techniques for reviewing designs, plans, specifications, estimates, reports and recommendations; current trends and developments, literature, and sources of information regarding municipal engineering; related laws, ordinances, rules and regulations. Ability to plan and coordinate professional and sub-professional engineering work; interpret and apply related laws, ordinances, rules, regulations and policies; prepare and present reports; perform complex professional engineering work; communicate effectively both orally and in writing; establish and maintain cooperative working relationships.

Special Requirements

Possession of a certificate of registration as a Civil Engineer issued by the California State Board of Registration for Civil and Professional Engineers. Possession of or ability to obtain an appropriate California driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record.

Questions regarding the equivalencies listed above? Please email us at careers@cityofrc.us.

WHERE DO YOU GO FROM HERE

APPLICATION PROCESS

All applicants are required to apply online at www.cityofrc.us. This position will close on Thursday, August 14, 2025 at 5:00pm

or until a sufficient number of applications have been received.

Applications must be complete and demonstrate that the minimum qualifications are met. All statements made on the application are subject to investigation and verification. Resumes may be attached to completed application form as supplemental information and will not be accepted in lieu of an official application form. Applications will be screened and the most qualified candidates who best match the needs of the City will be invited to compete further in the examination process. All candidates will be notified of their application status by email throughout the recruitment process. Candidates invited to compete in the examination process, who successfully pass the examination process, will be place on an eligibility list. The candidate on the eligibility list who most closely meets the requirements of the City may be selected to receive a final offer. The City may conclude that none of the candidates, even those who meet the minimum qualifications, are appropriate for the position.

Successful Candidates Shall Be Required To

Pass a reference and background verification. References will not be contacted until a mutual interest has been established, and
Provide proof of a valid California driver's license and be insurable; and
Degree Verification; and
Pass a pre-employment medical exam

If hired, candidate will be required to complete a verification form designated by Immigration and Naturalization Service to certify that they are eligible for employment in the United States of America and furnish proof certifying legal authorization to work in the United States.

The City of Rancho Cucamonga Participates in E-Verify. Federal law requires all employers to verify the identity and employment eligibility of all persons hired to work in the United States. In accordance, the City will provide the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security and Social Security Administration, with information from each new employee's Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. For additional information regarding E-Verify, the Federal Government's online employment eligibility verification system, please visit www.uscis.gov.

In addition, the City of Rancho Cucamonga abides by a nepotism policy which may preclude you from being hired if the City employs a relative. jobs.title: Data Analyst - Up to $200k USD + Bonus! - New York (Hybrid) - Trading Firm
jobs.description:
Role:
Data Analyst – Data & AI
Salary:
$200,000 Base + Discretionary Bonus!
Location:
New York
Working Style:
Hybrid

A well-established financial services trading firm in New York
is expanding its data function and is looking for a Data Analyst
who enjoys getting stuck into problems where the data is rarely neat, complete or ready to use. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics and applied AI
.

This isn’t a role focused purely on producing reports or dashboards. You’ll be close to the underlying data — figuring out where it comes from, whether it can be trusted, how it should be structured and what can be automated.

You could find yourself:

Working with Python and SQL
to transform and interrogate large datasets.
Helping build and maintain processes that move data from external sources into internal systems.
Finding inconsistencies that aren’t immediately obvious and working backwards to understand why they occurred.
Designing checks that catch bad or unexpected data before it reaches downstream users.
Experimenting with LLMs and machine learning
to extract useful information from documents and other unstructured sources.
Building small prototypes, testing different approaches and measuring whether they actually work.
Helping turn successful AI experiments into dependable production processes.
Bringing new datasets into the business by understanding their structure, mapping fields and working through integration requirements.

What We’re Looking For

Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics
or another quantitative discipline.
Strong Python and SQL
skills, whether developed professionally, academically or through substantial personal projects.
Experience working with data that requires more than straightforward analysis — particularly large, inconsistent or imperfect datasets
.
Hands-on exposure to machine learning, NLP or LLMs
.
Experience using LLMs for practical tasks such as classification, extraction, summarisation or document processing
.

If this sounds like the type of role you’d be interested in, please apply or get in touch directly for more information!

Contact: agreen@hunterbond.com

Location: Remote

Division: R&D

About Sedbox

Sedbox is a technology consulting company focused on equipping customers with the capabilities and support to conduct intelligent and successful cyber, AI, embedded, and application development operations. We do this by finding the most talented engineers and operators in the country, give them some of the most challenging technical problems facing our clients, and help them unleash their creativity and problem-solving skills. Excellence is our standard and mission success is our metric.

Visit SEDBOX at www.sedbox.ca.

The Team

Sedbox's R&D team leverages the power of analytics, robotics, and cognitive technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, create and manage large-scale organizational intelligence, and generate insights that catalyze growth and efficiencies.

Qualifications

Required

Strong technical skills including understanding of software development principles
Must be comfortable operating in a linux environment
Strong technical experience with Python programming
Working knowledge of Git
Ability to write clean code, document bugs, test code before publishing making sure it works
Ability to articulate reasons behind the design choices being made
Ability to build and test solution in agile delivery manner
Ability to complete tasks independently

Nice to have

Expert in Golang, Dart
Designing and developing RESTful API’s
Knowledge on Google cloud or AWS
Any bigdata certification is a plus
Designing and building applications in microservices architectures
Comfortable developing and deploying containerized workloads
Ability to work with a Kubernetes based deployment
Write test automations
Experience designing or utilizing ML or NLP tools or solutions
Databases: SQL or Non-SQL or Firebase
Google cloud or AWS
Prior experience with web UI development (React or Angular), and Graphical User Interface conceptualization and development

About You

You see the potential in intelligent technologies to change the world and you want a career where you’ll get to make this happen personally. You want to work for a fast-paced growing company that thinks big and dreams huge. You are motivated, view work as more than just a job, and are never satisfied with less than 100% effort. You want to be surrounded by people like you: creative, fun-loving, and passionate about their work. You are motivated by making an impact on your workplace and you thrive on challenging and rewarding problems.

Not only do you write reliable software, but you like the thought of working on projects that interact with the world. You're looking for a job where you get to interact with a diverse team and learn something new every day.

Resume guidelines

Make sure to attach links to your projects, github repo, relevant job qualifications content that is not proprietary in nature in your resume! We would love to see what you have accomplished in the past and what you are working on right now!

At Sedbox, we are committed to building and supporting a culture of diversity, inclusion, and accessibility. We hire the best talent regardless of race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, veteran status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression.
